scripts.dev: pkill -f "http.server 8000" || true && npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory dist
scripts.start: pkill -f "http.server 8000" || true && npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory dist
scripts.build: npm install --prefix windows && npm --prefix windows run build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/windows && cp index.html dist/ && cp -R images dist/ && cp -R macos dist/ && cp -R ubuntu dist/ && if [ -d windows/.background ]; then cp -R windows/.background dist/windows/; fi && cp -R windows/build/. dist/windows/ && cp -R windows/public/. dist/windows/ && cp -R windows/img dist/windows/ && cp -R windows/font dist/windows/ && cp -R windows/locales dist/windows/ && cp -R windows/edge dist/windows/ && cp -R windows/*.js dist/windows/ && cp -R windows/*.css dist/windows/ && cp -R windows/*.ico dist/windows/ && cp windows/manifest.json dist/windows/
